balls.text: top-edged and this time, would you believe it, there's no-one within the circle to catch it! it's gone so high that someone could have run in from somewhere to get to it, but no-one does and they have managed to carve out another couple of runs there, brings up AB de Villiers' 50 as well!
this is nothing new this over, he's now taken him over the short fine-leg region, was looking to bend down, across the off stump and scoops the slower one over to the fence
bow to the master, outside the off stump, fuller too and what does the master do? he reverse sweeps it over the fine third-man region for another four

six more, this is crazy hitting from ABD but more vitally, it is a poor ball from a frustrated bowler, short of length and a very slow ball that allows him to adjust his stroke and hits it over the long-off fielder for a six
and now smacked over the bowler's head for a four! he gets under that fuller length ball yet again and to the fence

there are shots and then there are shots, and then, there are these things from AB de Villiers, it was very wide outside the off stump and he moves towards the ball, sweeps it from and over the deep square-leg for a six, mind you, that's a fastish bowler we are talking about
tries to drill it through this time, it's fuller in length but for the third time this over, he does not get any bat on it
crunched this time, it was short of length and he has gone down the track and smashed him through the extra-cover for a four!
and again, bit of grip on the wicket, it's almost turned away from the batsman, slowly too and beats the batsman again
outside the off stump and bit of movement away from the bat, beats it and through to the keeper
fuller outside the off stump and driven through the covers for a single
slower from the bowler, on the leg stump, short of length, pushed to the leg side for a couple

wow, what a shot! he gives himself room by going away outside the leg stump and he cracks it over the in-field on the off side, manages so much power than it flies over for a six! Okay the third ump now has a look and changes it to a four
powerful shot, was very full and that's teed off from the spot, gone all the way for a six over the long-off region
up to the bat and outside the off stump, he wants to drive it through the covers, straight to the fielder at short cover
very full and it's outside the leg stump, he lifts his left leg and drives it down to long-on for a single
fuller on the off stump and he wants to smack it away, straight to the fielder at mid-off
fuller on the middle stump and hit it to long-on region, does not hit the middle of the bat, single there
very full from the bowler and it's tapped back to his left, dives across but fails to stop it cleanly and they are away for a couple of runs
driven down the ground for a couple of run, a very quickly run second by the duo
and once again, a four! this one's a fuller one and he's got an outside edge through the slip region to the fence!
under edged and through Uthappa's legs for a four! that's a shorter one and the cut was on but gets a four behind the keeper
full-toss and that's hit over the inner-field for a single
sightly fuller from Rahul and the ball turns away too, beats the outside edge of the bat
shorter in length this time and he pulls back the pace too, its punched through the covers for a single
top-edged while playing that scoop shot and it goes over the wicket-keeper's head for a one-bounce four!
short of length and that's easily pulled away for a four, it was right in the slot for the batsman to go for that shot
outside the off stump and he's opened the face of the bat to tap it to the off side for a single to get off the mark
short of length, outside the off and he's easily punched it away to the off side for a single

gone this time, easily caught at short fine-leg! this is fuller on the off stump, and he was looking to scoop it over the short fine-leg fielder who was inside the circle, does not get it off the middle and it's gone high and to the fielder, simple catch
fuller on the leg side and driven down the ground for a single
on his pads and flicked away to the leg side for a single
what a shot! short in length and it is punched over the extra-cover region for a four, a punchy stroke that
quicker on the leg stump and he's pushed it to the off side
jumps out again and drives it down to long-off for a single
short in length and he cuts it, Finch picks it up and throws it down at the non-striker's end, hits the stumps and they are off for a ricochet
and this time he goes down the ground and hits it over the bowler's head for a couple of runs to bring up his half-century, that's his first for the RCB
that's a bad ball, very short and in the right area for Tiwary to hit it across, he hoicks it over the deep square-leg region for a six
full-toss, almost waist-high from the bowler and it's tapped down to long-on for a single
shorter in length and he can go back and caress it through the point region for a couple of runs
fuller on the stumps and its defended forward to the off side
shorter in length and easily pulled away by the batsman, down to deep square-leg for a single
bowled him, he was looking to hit it across the line and Kohli's been castled! this was not as full as the previous one, he was looking to swipe it over mid-wicket but misses, bowled, two down now!
outside the off stump and gets enough width to squeeze it through the point region for a couple of runs
fuller in length for Kohli too, has to jab down his bat in time and pushed to the leg side
fuller from the bowler yet again, that seems to be his tactic against Tiwary, he's drilled him down to long-off for a single
fullish outside the off yet again and he gets some bat on this one but it's gone straight to Yuvraj at backward point
on the off stump, fuller there and he's unable to get it through, to the keeper
bludgeoned back by Tiwary and it hits the stumps at the non-striker's end, slows it down to long-off after that
outside the off and turning away, opens the face and guides it to short third-man for a single
was looking to come down the track but pushes it to the off side this time
thwack, hits it straight and it beats the bowler, but no power in the shot and fielded by the fielder from long-off
outside the off stump and cut away to point, gets a couple of runs to Suman
shorter in length from Rahul and pulled away to long-on for a single
opens the face of the bat and guides it to short third-man for another run
what a shot, that's been drilled through extra-cover this time and for a four, it was half-volley length and he takes full toll
shorter from the bowler, flicked away to the leg side for a single
and now he opens the face of the bat and guides it through to shirt third-man for a single
full-toss and banged through the covers this time, bad, bad ball this from Yuvraj but a good shot to play to get him eight from two
short of length from Yuvraj and that's pulled hard for a four, gets the placement and through mid-wicket to the fence
on his pads, tucked away to the leg side for a single and now they come back for a quickly run second, well done by Kohli
slower one outside the off stump and he was looking to cut it, the ball just does not arrive and he looks a tad nonplussed as it goes through to the keeper
fuller on the off stump and flicked away to the leg side for a single
fuller on the leg stump, flicked away to the leg side for a single
another one, beats the keeper and it's given as five wides again! outside the off stump this, bad miss by the keeper again, although I don't think it was that wide
on the middle stump line, bit of extra bounce and tapped away to the leg side for a single, he wanted a second but Tiwary rightly sends him back
full on his pads and he flicks it away to the leg side, runs down to short fine-leg for a single
down the leg side, poorly kept and it runs away for five wides, the problem with that one was that Robin's up to the stumps and the ball was a quicker one, runs away to the fence
opens the face of the bat and guides it through to the short third-man for a single
another one that's shorter, cut to the cover fielder
outside the off stump and that's cut hard by Kohli, it's kept a tad low too, played well
shorter in length this time, punched down the ground for a single
shorter in length and it's pulled away through the mid-wicket region for a four
down the track and that's gone all the way for a six I think! Checking with the third ump. He's got it, Nayar caught it well but had to back-pedal over the fence, gets his six runs!
goes down the track and Rahuls almost bowled it on his own toes, obviously cannot get to the pitch of the ball and has to be content pulling it to long-on for a single
he's immediately back and punching it down to the long-off fielder for a single
quicker and flatter on the off stump, no turn there and that's tapped back to the long-off fielder for a single
another one that's quite short from Rahul, this is cut away to the deep point region for a single
shorter in length outside the off and cut it away to the off side for a single
shorter in length, in fact very short but the lack of bounce makes it difficult for the batsman, even the lack of pace does the same and he gets himself a single to mid-wicket
fuller this time and he flicks it off the front foot, runs down to fine-leg but it's not hit hard enough which means that they can come back for the second
shorter in length and punched down the ground for a single by the captain
shorter in length and cut through the covers for a single

and now he's gone, big, big fish and a good, good catch! Gayle was looking to repeat that stroke, only this time he was looking to play it over mid-wicket than hitting it straight, gets bit of an outside edge and it's gone very high in the air, Bhuvneshwar has to run across to his left and he takes a very good catch there, Gayle's gone for 21
the first one, the first six and it's hit over the bowler's head, took his time to hit this one, fuller and smacked over the bowler's head
short of length and he wants to cut it away, it is on the off stump and no turn, tapped back
fuller on his pads and neatly tucked it away to deep mid-wicket for a single

and that's well fielded by Yuvraj this time, it was cut away and he dives to his left and gets the ball, throws it back to the bowler with the batsman outside the crease, they get an overthrow in the end
quicker from Mathews and he's trying to pull it away, shorter in length too, the ball just does not come on there!
another slower one from Mathews, he was looking to give room but the ball turns a tad away and beats the bat, beats the stumps and kept well
goes through the covers and for a four, it was short of length and he goes down the wicket and cracks it, it was misfielded by Yuvraj at the point region, bad effort
slower from the bowler and outside the off, gets the inside edge over the stumps and keeper for a single
shorter, quicker and on the off stump, pushed into the covers, not for runs though
fuller from the bowler, pushes it to the off side and is away for a single
on his pads yet again but not quite in his zone to unwind, tries to flick it away but hits his pads
on his pads yet again, tapped away to short mid-wicket for another one
on his pads now and is easily tucked away to the leg side for a single
on the front foot and he defends it back to the bowler
was looking to smack it over the mid-wicket region, gets the bottom of the bat and it runs away to third-man for a single
ooh, jags back into the batsman from over the wicket, he was looking to play it like an out-swinger, trying to cut it, but has to change his shot
this is too short from Bhuvi and it's cracked through extra-cover for a four, slower too and easily hit
tapped away to the covers, on a good length but straight to the fielder
well bowled, slower one and Gayle was looking to go down the pitch and smack it over, it keeps very low and was wide outside the off stump
swings back into the batsman who defends without moving too much of his feet, takes his bottom hand off too
very full from the bowler and hit only to extra-cover, straight to him, a decent bowling start
fuller from Suman and it's hit to long-on for a single, was in the air too
short of length and that's pulled hard but straight to mid-wicket for a single
fuller on the leg stump and pushed away to he leg side for a single
on his pads, no turn there and thuds into his pads and rolls over to the leg side for a leg-bye
up and over and gets it over mid-off, he was giving himself room, couple of runs there
fuller outside the off and he manages to get his foot out, taps it to short cover
fullish on the middle and he finally gets his bat out, pad out and drives it down to long-on for a single
bit of turn back into the bowler and it's tucked away to square-leg, four dots in a row
fuller on the off stump, not real turn and it's defended back to the bowler
shorter in length and he wants to cut it away, keeps a tad low, straight to the point fielder
fuller on the off stump, pushed into the covers and to the fielder
closer to his pad, no swing, hits his pads as he is looking to flick it away, misses
cut away and for a four, short of length and Gayle taps it gently, beats the backward point, and the cover fielder to the fence
outside the off and that's let go, shouldering arms to Bhuvneshwar, who was incidentally the best Pune bowler in that 175-game
punched through backward point for a single, it was swinging away from the bat and done well to get it away
on his pads, tucked away to the leg side for a couple of runs, between the square-leg fielder inside the circle and the deep fine-leg
swing back into the batsman again, this time it's from outside the off and defended back to the bowler
swing down the leg side and at some pace too, Tiwary looks to flick it down but the swing beats him, wide called though
wow, he has actually almost helicoptered it over the bowler's head for a four...
fuller on the middle stump and driven back to the bowler
goes to slam it over and that's gone to the bowler, who fields it off his bowling
fuller on his pads, hits it and rolls over to the leg side for a single
and gone, Gayle's got his first wicket, lbw and that's the end of the ninth, lbw trying to hoick it over the leg side
on his pads, keeps it up to the bat and flicked over the in-field to get him a single
full-toss and he manages to tap it to the off side for a single
he was looking to slog it away again and can only get it on the bounce to mid-off, single for him

and this is as easy as you like, Kohli gets a catch, RP gets a wicket and Bangalore have almost got a win...short of length and he was looking to play it over long-off, not too much timing and it's gone straight to the fielder
short of length and he wants to pull it across the line, not too much timing and it spoons up to long-on for a single
tries to scoop it over the short fine-leg but it sneaks under his bat and through to the keeper
opens the face of the bat and pushes it to the off side for a single
slow turn away again, flicked away to the leg side for a single

and this time he's gone, an excellent innings comes to an end there. it was shorter in length and somehow it seemed stuck into the pitch, but of turn away from the bat and he was looking to play across the line, gets the outside edge and lobs up gently for RP to get the catch
and straight again, he was going down the pitch, seemed like he could get cramped by it but it's hit over the bowler's head for a four, well played
fuller outside the off stump and driven down the ground for a couple of runs, well-run that by the pair

full-toss and that's hit straight to long-on, tough catch made it look very easy! it was smacked hard, does not get it off the middle of the bat and de Villiers runs in and takes it low down, six down now
looks to play it through short third-man but gets it to the fielder there, only a single there
slower one from the bowler, he's punched it straight to long-off for a single
clean as a whistle, it was on the middle, it was full and he's not swung it across as he has been doing all this innings, he goes straight and smack, six!
fuller on the middle stump and pushed to mid-wicket for a single, brings Robin back on strike
short of length and he was trying to pull it over, it's too high for him, no run there

full-toss and Gayle's taken it at point! he got it on the full and Mathews wanted to crack it through the point, gets the toe end of the bat and it lobs up to the left of Gayle at point who dives and grabs it well
on the up, wanted to play it over the off side, misses the outside edge of the bat, there was a bit of bounce on that one too
outside the off and that's moved away a tad further, wide given by the umpire
cut away, quicker from the bowler and close to the stumps, gets it away to the off side for  a single
whoa, whoa, whatever they had during that time-out, I want it too! it's pitched up and that's been spanked over the long-on region now and for a big, big six!
and now the sweep that gets him a single to deep square-leg
whoa, what a shot, what a superb shot, he slogs it over deep square-leg now for another six, not too much of respect for Murali!
goes down the pitch and hits it over the bowler yet again, a single to long-on
shot, six, this is superb batting from Mathews, it was pitched right up to the bat and he smashes it over the long-on region for a six, can they get closer
and now he's down the track yet again and is looking to hit straighter, misses and it goes through to the keeper
full-toss and that's been crashed through mid-wicket for a four, the long-on fielder ran to his right and had to dive but he wasn't getting close to it
and now he goes down the track and it was a rather quicker and wider one, does not get anything on the bat and the bowler goes for a rather prolonged appeal, even the keeper does not join in
that's a classy slog, if at all there was one! it was on the middle, on a length and he smokes it over the mid-wicket region for a six, that's come off the middle of the bat to get him to his 50
he was giving himself room there and gets no bat on it, in fact the bat hits the ground and the keeper tries to run him out
wants to pull it away and it goes to short mid-wicket, does not get any timing on it
works it down to the leg side for a couple of runs to wide long-on
swung away for a six! that was a length ball and spinning away from the batsman, he plays it across and gets it over deep mid-wicket for a six
and this has been spanked to the leg side, between wide long-on and deep mid-wicket fielder, well fielded by Murali who uses his foot to push the ball back
goes down the track and smacks it, does not get the middle of the bat, and it goes to the leg side
dances down the track and smack, hit off the middle of bat and it seems to have come off the fingers of Kartik before going down to long-off
shorter in length from Kartik and pulled away to long-on for a single
another one to end the 13th and get them to the time-out with 90 more needed to win
full-toss and driven down the ground for a single
on a length and defended to the off side for a single this time
and he was attempting to do the same again, moving away to the off side and trying to smoke it over the leg side, its a slower ball and the inside edge gets him a single
and wow, what a shot, he moves away to the off side and flicks it over the in-field and into the deep square-leg region for a six!

shortish in length and what's happened there. first there's a bit of a misfield from the captain which allows them to get back for the second, the ball gets to VK who throws it to at the striker's end but the keeper's too far from there and they get overthrows
short of length and punched down the ground for a single

whoa, he's missed a stumping here, it was outside the off stump and he was looking to go down the track and drive it down, the spin does him in and he's over balanced out of the crease, the keeper does not collect it properly and misses a stumping
driven straight to the short cover fielder, Kohli fields
leading edge and it falls short of Kohli this time, just short for the second time this innings
on the middle stump, bit of turn away from the bat and it's knocked out to the leg stump
shorter in length this time and cuts it away to deep point for a single
fuller on the off stump and whips it down to long-on for a single

edged and gone! Smith's caught behind! he was going down the pitch and trying to crash it through the covers, gets a thin outside edge and it's easily caught by the keeper, another one bites the dust here
and that's another one that's short but this time he does not try to go across the line, in fact, he punches it through the point region and it rushes off to the fence
and he walks down and wants to pull it away, was a big heave across the line, misses, through to the keeper
outside the off stump and it's kept a tad low here, beaten outside the off stump

gone this time, caught at long-on, Yuvi's gone! he was looking good and was going after anything he thought he could, was a short of length ball and wanted to pull it away, does not time it too well this time and it goes straight to the long-on fielder, easily caught
shortish in length but ripping back into the batsman, defended to the off side and wants a run but Yuvraj sends him back
and this is quicker and flatter but way down the leg side and rightly called a wide
opens the face of the bat and guides it to the off side for a single now
defended off the front foot, pushed to the mid-off region
swept away, hard hit shot and that's run away to the deep square-leg region for a single
goes for the sweep now and is hit on his pads, there's an appeal for an lbw but not-out, hitting outside off
down the ground and for a six! it was very full from Muralitharan and it's spanked over the bowler's head for a six!
slower one from MH and that's spanked over long-on for a six! that's exactly what the Warriors need from Yuvraj and they are getting it for now!
on the back foot and defended to the off side, off for a single
slapped, forehanded almost, short of a length and he was moving back and almost smacks it with a horizontal bat through wide mid-off
round the stumps and on a good length, pushed into the covers for a single
up and over from Yuvraj! it was very full from the bowler and he drives it over the mid-off fielder to the fence, he seems to be in a positive mood
goes down the pitch and smacks it through to long-on, not off the middle of the bat and it runs through for a single
defended on the off side, wanted a single too but Robin sends him back
was hitting the pad and there's bit of an appeal but was hitting outside off again
and now he wants to open the face of the bat, gets the inside edge of the bat and it rolls over for a couple
wants to sweep it down but Yuvraj misses that one, quickish turn too for the bowler
turn away from the batsman and leaves it alone for the keeper
outside the line of the off stump, wants to sweep it away, hits the pads and they are away for a single, appeal for lbw but struck outside off

gone, out, run-out! shorter in length, he was looking to run it down to third-manand they try to go for the second, chancing Muralitharan's arm, it's a decent throw over the stumps and hes short there! the on-field umpire did not even call the third umpire there!
short of length and it's pushed down the ground for a single
on his pads and that's flicked away to the leg side, beats the fine-leg easily, and the deep square-leg fielder too
and continues with that off stump line, length ball and pushed it to the off side
outside the off, shorter and slower and pushed it to the point region
shorter in length and on the off stump, swings away from the batsman and he runs it down to third-man for a single

tough chance dropped! it was fuller on the middle stump and he decides to go over the bowlers head, the long-off was outside, the mid-on was in and Muralitharan inside the circle gets a hand to it, but isn't able to hold on.
shorter in length and pushed to the mid-off, the bowler tries to field it but cannot stop it and the non-striker, after some difficulty gets over to the striker's end
a very slow ball and within the stumps, he was looking to unwind before deciding to defend it away to the off side for a single
bouncer now and he was looking to pull it away, does not get it off the middle, rolls over to the fielder on the leg side
outside the off stump, short, wide and wanted to cut it, but there was no foot movement there from the batsman and beaten
on his pads and that's neatly tucked away to deep square-leg for a single

gone is it, no it's on the half volley, short of length from the bowler and he's looking to punch it through the covers, gets it in the air and Kohli takes it acrobatically, just falling short of the fielder
fuller on the off stump and driven to mid-off, they are away for a quick one and the throw from ABD almost hits Dar
leg-glances it away to the fence, it was on the middle stump and angling down and Uthappa glances it through the very fine, fine-leg region for a four
shorter in length and on his pads, does not get up too much and is easily worked away to wide mid-on for a single
and now it's on the middle stump, pushes it back to the bowler, not for runs
outside the off stump, not too much on the ball but he punches it through the line of the ball and gets it over the in-field on the off side
wants to open the face of the bat and run it through the third-man region, gets it straight to the short third-man fielder

outside edge and that's put down by the keeper! it was outside the off stump and he was looking to swing it through the line, gets the edge and it flies to his right, gets his gloves to it but spills it
on the off stump, pushes it into the covers and not for runs
slows the pace down and bowls at the good length and on the off stump, pushes it to the off side for a single again
short of length and outside the off stump, he opens the face of the bat and guides it to the off side, single taken
walks over to the off side and plays it to deep square-leg for a single
down the leg side yet again and left alone by the batsman, wide called
yorker length ball and there's a huge appeal for an lbw, it seemed too quick for him and sneaks through the bat and pad, umpire's not giving it, misses the stumps by some quirk of fate
and now he's gone! Six and out! this was wider outside the off stump and he tries to repeat the same stroke, gets an inside edge and is bowled, big wicket given his form
thwack, six, over the mid-wicket region this time! it was on a length and he reads it well, goes through with his swing and muscles it over the in-field
punched down to mid-on for quickly taken run, there's a direct hit which has been referred to the third ump, just safe according to the replays
bouncer from MH and Uthappa ducks under it to allow it to go through to the keeper
very full from the bowler and that's hit off his back foot, can only get it away to mid-on, for a single
on his pads and that's flicked away to the leg side for a single
short of length from the bowler and this one keeps low, he was looking to pull it away but it does not rise too much
cut away to the fence for a four, it was short and not very wide but wide enough to get the punch shot out, seemed to have bounced a tad more too
was looking to defend off the front foot, gets an outside edge that runs across to the third-man for a single
was moving to the off stump and it hits his pads, rolls across to the leg side for a single
down the leg side from the bowler and that's let go for the ump to call a wide
outside the off stump and it's angled across the batsman, was looking to defend off the front foot, beats the outside edge
fuller on the off stump and he punches it down to long-off for a single
shortens his length this time, pushed to the leg side for a single
quicker, flatter and on the off stump, tapped back to the bowler
slightly shorter in length and that's tucked away to the leg side for a quickly taken run
fuller from Kartik and he gets his pad out and defends it back to the bowler
fuller on the off stump from round the stumps and pushed into the off side, single to get off the mark
